title: Textreader
description: Reads and sends text from various text sources into chat
body:
# Textreader
Textreader is a utility datapack for sending text sources like Signs, Books and Text Displays into chat.

![Banner](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c5e6f59c-8321-4867-8611-947247e899aa)

## How to Use
Textreader's menu can be accessed via the `Quick Actions` key (`G` by default) which will give you multiple choices to send text sources to chat.
### Brief Usage
- Send contents of Signs and Text Displays by looking at them.
- Books can be sent by holding them in the main hand.
  - Lecterns have to be stood on to have their contents sent.
- Players can choose to reveal the text source's position with `textreader.c_send_pos`
  - Does not include the dimension and is not supported by books.
